mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 indicates strong job growth, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS increase and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -1% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.
